Mountain Report

Summer time baby! The Karen and Sid DeBoer Lodge is open for summer Fridays-Sundays until Sept. 2nd. Check out our operating schedule here!

There are a number of things to do on your local mountain playground this summer! Utilize our summer trail map to plan your adventure and stop by the lodge for a bite to eat or a refreshing beverage. Grab some ice cream and enjoy the mountain views! If you forgot your sunscreen or want some Mt. A summer merch, we’ve got you covered with our retail items.

 

Updated November 10, 2026 at 6:20 PM

Mt. Ashland’s Mountain Report is brought to you by Lithia Motors, through their Lithia4Kids program.

The 26/27 Winter Season is Right Around the Corner!

Have You Heard the News About our Windsor Chairlift Replacement?

The Mt. Ashland Team is thrilled to welcome our guests back to the slopes once the snow starts flying!
In the meantime, do your snow dances, pray for snow, praise Ullr and find the Mountain team at:
Ashland Festival of Light, Friday, November 27th
Medford Winter Light Festival, Saturday, December 5th
Curious about what the Mountain looks like RIGHT NOW? Make sure to check out our webcams for a fun sneak into what Mother Nature has in store for us. All webcams for the winter season will go live in early December, but you can still catch a glimpse of all the fun in store from our Lodge and Comer Cams.
SEE CAMS

WINDSOR CHAIRLIFT ANNOUNCEMENT

Your Local Mountain is thrilled to announce that thanks to our incredible Community,
the replacement of Windsor Chairlift in the spring of 2027 is fully funded.
You can read about that here:
LEARN MORE

GET READY FOR SEASON

If you purchased a 26/27 Season Pass, now is the time to pick it up!
The Mt. Ashland Business Office is open for pass purchasing and printing:
Monday – Friday
9:00 am – 5:00 pm
693 Washington Street, Suite A
Ashland, Oregon 97520
**Once season starts we will ONLY be printing passes at the Ski Area**

PASS MAILING

Sledding is not allowed at the Ski Area at any time.
